title: Canonicalize shared Git directory for worktree claims
description: Canonicalize the common Git directory before deriving the shared claims registry path, and cover aliases that resolve to the same physical repository path.
why: macOS can expose the same common Git directory through /var and /private/var paths, causing worktrees to calculate different machine-local claim registries. CI on macOS and one Windows runner then offered tickets claimed elsewhere.

acceptance.text: Equivalent paths to the same common Git directory use one shared claim registry
Cross-worktree claims remain hidden and conflicting claims are rejected across supported platforms

steps: Create a Git repository and a linked worktree
Claim a ticket in one worktree
Ask for ready work in the other worktree
repro.expected: The other worktree does not offer the claimed ticket and a conflicting claim is rejected.
repro.actual: GitHub Actions reported the claimed ticket as ready in macOS and Windows matrix jobs.

outcome.summary: Canonicalized the common Git directory with realpath before deriving the shared claim registry key; updated release documentation with the cross-platform CI blocker and current 0.1.2 gates.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check passed (122 passed, 1 optional model test skipped); plantool check reports 0 warnings; npm pack --dry-run lists 25 files for @mmilad/plantool@0.1.2 and excludes plan data.
